project_type: React 19 + TypeScript 5.9 + Vite 7 SPA for managing cat names with tournament/voting features
build_system: pnpm 10.27.0 with Vite 7, config at config/vite.config.ts
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom, config at config/vitest.config.ts, setup at config/vitest.setup.ts
build_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && pnpm run build
test_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && pnpm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm run build to verify no compilation errors. 2. Run pnpm run test to verify tests pass (1 pre-existing failure in sound.test.ts is expected). 3. Run pnpm run lint:types to verify no type errors.
setup_instructions: 1. mise use -g node@20.19.6. 2. npm install -g pnpm@10.27.0. 3. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
environment_constraints: Node 20.19.6 via mise. pnpm 10.27.0. Must prefix commands with eval "$(mise activate bash)". One pre-existing test failure in sound.test.ts (unrelated to our changes). Pre-existing Biome formatting errors do not block lint:types or tests.
contribution_requirements: Feature branches from main, clear commit messages (feat:/fix:/chore:). PRs must pass CI checks before merging.
key_patterns: Components in src/shared/components/layout/. Feature modules in src/features/. Store in src/store/ with Zustand slices. CSS modules in src/styles/. Framer Motion used for animations. Button component already has min-h-[44px] on mobile sizes. AppLayout already has skip-to-content link and main landmark. Modal has focus trap and escape handling. FormPrimitives have aria-invalid and aria-describedby patterns. Reduced motion partially supported in motion.css and TournamentAnnouncements. useReducedMotion from framer-motion used in Tournament.tsx.
directory_structure: src/app/ - App shell, routes, providers. src/features/ - tournament, dashboard feature modules. src/shared/ - reusable components, hooks, libs, services. src/store/ - Zustand store with slices. src/styles/ - CSS files. config/ - vite/vitest/biome configs. public/ - static assets.
